_about: Registry of every register whose entries carry an expiry clock (PLAN-v3 §2.4, D2-04/D2-19). validate_expiry_clocks.py walks each register's `entries` path and requires `review_by` (ISO date; FAIL when past, warn within 14 d) and `spec_pin` (8-hex lock commit per version in scope; FAIL on drift) on every entry — unless `clock` is `none` (retirements: a sanctioned retirement is a permanent fact about a pinned spec). `scope` says which spec version(s) an entry's truth depends on: `versions` (entry.versions list), `version` (entry.version), `all` (every registered version), `none` (no spec pin — the entry is about the site, not a pin). `clock_tier` (D2-19, decision 23): `moving` = truth depends on upstream pins/goldens/external tools (30 d); `pin-only` = truth depends only on the spec pin (90 d). Later additions per plan: expected_skips_* (D1-10), known_issues.json (D5-07), known_tag_moves.json (D2-17), official_crosscheck_allowlist.json, known_sdk_drops.json, known_external_agent_divergences.json. add_expiry_clocks.py stamps missing hands; the seed batch is recorded in review_signoffs.json as `expiry-clock-seed-2026-09`.

registers.name: site_claims
registers._note: review_by already owned and enforced by site_gates.py (D5); listed so one gate sees every clock. scope none: a claim has no spec pin; nothing is stamped here.

registers.name: known_issues
registers._note: D5-07 <- D2-04 (W0 integration 2026-09-10): review_by (<= 90 d) seen by this gate; the re_verified <= 30 d freshness clock is owned by conformance/ci/validate_known_issues.py. scope none: a row is pinned by the file's own spec_pin, nothing is stamped here. conformance/agent/agent_run_evidence.json carries no review_by - its 30-day window is agent_matrix/agent_governance's own clock (D5-04) - so it is deliberately not listed.
